text: Encyclopedia Mysenvaria is published.
Start of the Golden Age. (end. 1214 AT)
End of the Golden Age. (beg. 609 AT)
Start of the Post-War Era. (end. 609 AT)
End of the Post-War Era. (beg. 0 AT)
The Iteration Period begins with the creation of the first organism by the God of Hydrogen Cyanide. It lasts until 55 BT and sees the creation of over 99% of all organisms to ever be created.
The Iteration Period ends following the passing of the Creations Act. 99% of all organisms which will ever exist were created since the start of the period.
The Quickening begins following the publication of the Quickening Star. An estimated 15 billion Gods are created over less than a single season.

Start of the Early-War Epoch. (end. 116 BT)
End of the Early-War Epoch (beg. 116 BT), start of the Mid-War Epoch. (end. 55 BT)
End of the Mid-War Epoch (beg. 55 BT), start of the Late-War Epoch. (end. 0 AT)
The Dying Period begins (end. 160 BT) following the First Death. It doesn't end until 160 BT, after the passing of three quarters of all Gods that have ever existed.

The Dying Period ends (beg. 177 BT) after the passing of three quarters of all Gods which have ever existed. An estimated 11.2 billion Gods have passed away in seventeen years, over 1.9 million Gods per day.

Following the First God Council the Great Fog is shrunk drastically, to the scope known in the modern day. Millions of Gods are displaced and forced to migrate poleward, starting the Great Poleward Fog Migration.
The Great Poleward Fog Migration ends after a period of one season.

The God of Fulgurite holds the First Convening. Of the 20 Gods invited only 16 arrive. Each invitee had witnessed the First Death. The event sees the formation of many ideas and theories regarding the beginning war.
Start of the Great Flood. (end. 11 BT)
End of the Great Flood. (beg. 25 BT)
Start of the Modern Era. (ongoing)
The modern day.
As Gods' manipulations of time and space grow more severe the Gods of Time and Space pass the Spatial Act.
Following the First Convening the God of Fulgurite would publish the Convening Star, detailing the organizing of the event, the attendees, the discussions held, and the conclusions drawn.
Following Fulgurite's passing at the hands of Sodium Ethyl Xanthate they would republish many of Fulgurite's stars, including the Convening Star.
Following God of Sodium Ethyl Xanthate's own passing their close sibling God of Diethyl Dixanthogen Disulfide would republish many of their stars, including the Convening Star.

The God of Carbon publishes the Quickening Star to document their creation of the Carbon Compound Gods via domain subdivision. Other Elemental Gods follow behind, publishing their own stars and creating the Quickening System.
